business_purpose: A synthetic business that may become a client; one business can generate several leads.
grain: one row per synthetic business prospect

business_purpose: An acquisition request for a prospect captured through a channel.
foreign_keys: prospect_id -> crm_business_prospect; duplicate_group_id -> crm_duplicate_group; surviving_lead_id -> crm_lead; territory_id -> crm_territory; cma_code_sgc2021 -> analytics.dim_cma
relationships: 1 lead : many source touches, assignments, activities, status rows, SLA events; 0..1 opportunity

business_purpose: Every channel touch that created or re-created a lead, preserved through duplicate merges.
grain: one row per lead source touch
foreign_keys: lead_id -> crm_lead; original_lead_id -> crm_lead; channel_code -> crm_acquisition_channel; campaign_id -> crm_campaign

business_purpose: Synthetic marketing campaigns used for attribution.
Synthetic relationship managers who own leads.
relationships: 1 RM : many assignments, territories, specializations, capacity snapshots

business_purpose: Hypothetical territory definitions keyed on SGC 2021 geography.
relationships: 1 territory : many RM territories and leads

business_purpose: Which RM covers which territory, and when.
grain: one row per RM x territory x effective period
relationships: many : many between RMs and territories

business_purpose: Industry specializations held by RMs, keyed on reviewed industry codes.
grain: one row per RM x industry x effective period
relationships: many : many between RMs and industries

business_purpose: Daily RM availability and weighted workload.
grain: one row per RM x snapshot date

business_purpose: Every routing evaluation with inputs, rule version and outcome.
foreign_keys: lead_id -> crm_lead; selected_rm_id -> crm_relationship_manager; rule_version_id -> crm_rule_version

business_purpose: Ownership of a lead by an RM or queue over time.
foreign_keys: lead_id -> crm_lead; rm_id -> crm_relationship_manager; routing_decision_id -> crm_routing_decision; prior_assignment_id -> crm_lead_assignment; rule_version_id -> crm_rule_version

business_purpose: Contact attempts, conversations, meetings and nurture tasks.
foreign_keys: lead_id -> crm_lead; rm_id -> crm_relationship_manager; assignment_id -> crm_lead_assignment

business_purpose: Every lead status change with its transition and event.
grain: one row per lead status change

business_purpose: SLA clocks and their warning, breach, met and escalation events.
grain: one row per SLA clock instance per lead or assignment
foreign_keys: lead_id -> crm_lead; assignment_id -> crm_lead_assignment; rule_version_id -> crm_rule_version

business_purpose: A set of leads judged to be the same business, with the survivor.
The qualified pursuit opened from a lead and its outcome.
grain: one row per opportunity (at most one per lead)

business_purpose: Versioned configuration of routing, SLA, capacity and duplicate rules.
grain: one row per rule set x version
relationships: 1 version : many decisions, assignments, SLA events, snapshots
